claimed_title: Executive Order 5084—Making Lessie L. Schaefer Eligible for Examination Without Regard to Age
text:
Executive Order 5084. March 28, 1929
Brecutive ^rbet
The rnaximum age limit of fifty years for admission to the general clerical
examination in the Eleventh United States Civil Service District which closes
April 5, 1929, is hereby waived to permit the examination of Mrs. Lessie L. Schaefer
of Pendleton, Oregon.
292
 
Herbert Hoover, 1929-1933 EO 5086
It is stated that Mrs. Schaefer is in good health, brilliant, thoroughly fitted and
experienced in clerical work, and that it is necessary that she be self-supporting.
HERBERT HOOVER
The White House,
March 28, 1929.
[No. 5084]
